hook: Bitcoin mining doesn't stop for Christmas.

scenes.narration: The network aims to produce one block about every ten minutes.
That target holds on weekdays, weekends and holidays alike.
If blocks come too fast or too slow, the target is adjusted every two thousand sixteen blocks.

cta: Mining or off today? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
title: Bitcoin Never Takes a Holiday
description_body: The network aims for one block about every 10 minutes, every day of the year.
